name: 建国西路618号住宅挑阳台与窗列

working_register.scope: Three storeys, brick/concrete and 1948 are supplied by the secondary register. The municipal row confirms the residence, the recorded institutional use and the street address.

archived_image.visible: A broad lower toplight over narrower casements, an upper window on the same right-hand jamb, an outboard horizontal slab with a solid balcony face, an open slit below its thin upper rail, the side return, slab soffit, roof lip and faint horizontal wall joints. Garden foliage covers part of the left end.
archived_image.scope: A single cropped upper-storey bay as photographed in 2013. The 1948 exterior, materials, unseen surrounds and original dimensions are unestablished. The copyrighted photograph is not redistributed.

use_history.content: The secondary account, citing the Shanghai Foreign Affairs Gazetteer, dates the move from 1400 West Nanjing Road to 618 West Jianguo Road to 1 August 1966. This is an occupation date, not the construction date.

historical_marker.scope: Public street-level reference rounded to three decimals. No contemporary structure or grounds are replaced.

uncertainties: Estimated scale, projected slab depth, width at the cropped left end, sill build-up and obscured repetition of the lower casements.
No dated photograph or measured drawing establishing the 1948 window joinery or render joints was recovered.
The shallow back is a model section. The lower storey, wider building, later functions and grounds fall outside the photographed detail.
